events.title: Isaac Newton publishes the Principia
events.description: Newton's Philosophiae Naturalis Principia Mathematica was published in London. It set out the laws of motion and universal gravitation, giving physics the framework that dominated science for more than two centuries.
events.html: Newton's Philosophiae Naturalis Principia Mathematica was published in London. It set out the laws of motion and universal gravitation, giving physics the framework that dominated science for more than two centuries.

events.title: French forces capture Algiers
events.description: The Dey of Algiers surrendered to a French expeditionary force, beginning 132 years of French rule in Algeria. The colonisation ended only after a long and bloody war of independence.
events.html: The Dey of Algiers surrendered to a French expeditionary force, beginning 132 years of French rule in Algeria. The colonisation ended only after a long and bloody war of independence.

events.title: William Booth begins the mission that becomes the Salvation Army
events.description: Methodist preacher William Booth began evangelising in London's East End, founding the Christian Mission. Renamed the Salvation Army in 1878, it grew into a worldwide church and charity.
events.html: Methodist preacher William Booth began evangelising in London's East End, founding the Christian Mission. Renamed the Salvation Army in 1878, it grew into a worldwide church and charity.

events.title: Louis Réard unveils the bikini at a Paris swimming pool
events.description: Engineer and designer Louis Réard presented his two-piece swimsuit at the Piscine Molitor, modelled by dancer Micheline Bernardini. He named it after Bikini Atoll, where atomic tests had just begun.
events.html: Engineer and designer Louis Réard presented his two-piece swimsuit at the Piscine Molitor, modelled by dancer Micheline Bernardini. He named it after Bikini Atoll, where atomic tests had just begun.

events.title: The National Health Service launches in Britain
events.description: Aneurin Bevan's National Health Service began, offering comprehensive care free at the point of use to everyone in Britain. It became one of the defining institutions of the post-war welfare state.
events.html: Aneurin Bevan's National Health Service began, offering comprehensive care free at the point of use to everyone in Britain. It became one of the defining institutions of the post-war welfare state.

events.title: Algeria becomes independent from France
events.description: Algeria proclaimed independence, 132 years to the day after French troops took Algiers. It followed an eight-year war of liberation and a referendum in which Algerians voted overwhelmingly for independence.
